idea: Grow a set of finished nodes. Always finish the closest unfinished node next, then see whether it gives its neighbours a shorter way. Once a node is finished its distance never changes.
time: O((V + E) log V) with a priority queue
useWhen: All weights are zero or positive and you need the shortest routes from one start node
Maps and road networks: shortest or fastest route
avoidWhen: Any edge is negative: the answer can be wrong without any warning (use Bellman-Ford)
You need the distance between every pair of nodes (use Floyd-Warshall)
